author: zebrazackattack
body:
http://imgur.com/a/B0iCg#0
       -My album of the build
This is designed as a CTM (Capture The Monument) map
-There are 3 monuments for each team.
-There are hidden diamond and iron blocks under and around the spawn as well as under the carpets at the entrance of the battle balcony, but be careful some diamond is dangerous.
Each player is provided with 
-a sword (knock back 1)
-a diamond pickaxe (efficiency 2) 
-4 golden apples
-a leather chest plate of (The color of their team)
-a Bow (infinity 1)
-a pair iron boots
-a stack of logs (Birch)
-32 golden carrots
-a stack of stained glass (The color of their team)

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
While the shape of it looks nice, it is quite flat and lacks space overall...
It would be eternal bridging from island to island just to run & get killed.
You should add more paths, more islands, make the map bigger (overall) and perhaps improve the monument rooms? They could look better :)
